Multiple Arrests Made in Various Financial Fraud Cases Across India

Authorities across India have reported multiple arrests in connection with significant financial fraud schemes. Incidents include cyber fraud involving online trading and cryptocurrency, as well as a case of selling Ministry of Defence property using forged documents. The amounts defrauded range from lakhs to crores of rupees, with police recovering various incriminating items like ATM cards, bank documents, and electronic devices.
